summary: Review of the 1.24.24 Sheets functions (SHEET_FN_* and the FORMULA/SHEET changes), Lantern commit cdd40b0, src sha256 38de8473342ad7b2. Oracle: LibreOffice 24.2 headless recalculation of the same cells written as an .xlsx (typed text converted as an en-US Excel user's typing would be: dates, times, TRUE, $, %, commas), except where LibreOffice lacks the function (XLOOKUP, XMATCH, TEXTBEFORE, TEXTAFTER) or is known to differ from Excel (errors LibreOffice exports as #VALUE! where Excel documents #NUM!/#N/A/#REF!; DATE with a two-digit year; DOLLAR of a negative; VLOOKUP of text against numbers; am/pm case; dynamic-array SUM): there the expected value is Excel's documented one, marked oracle='Excel documentation'. 908 cases: 764 agree, 141 disagree, 3 not counted (Excel's answer uncertain). Disagreements by cause: absolute $ references rejected: 5; blank cell or "" formula read as 0 / as blank: 27; an error anywhere in a range breaks the function: 11; typed dates skipped where cells are read directly: 11; exact float equality: 6; typed times, US dates, TRUE/FALSE, (100) are text; parseFloat in arithmetic: 15; array expressions and constants: 10; empty arguments: 9; doubled quotes inside a string: 6; TEXT format codes not handled: 9; whole-column references: 3; empty range in MAX/MIN/AVERAGE: 3; SUBTOTAL counts nested SUBTOTALs: 3; SUMIF short sum range not extended: 2; -x^2 precedence: 2; fractional arguments (EDATE/EOMONTH/ROUND digits/SMALL k): 5; DATEVALUE of a US m/d/yyyy date: 1; number to text in &: 2; text vs number ordering: 1; COUNT of text arguments: 1; grid shows a count as a date, or a date as a number: 9. fx search: 119 plain-word queries, the wanted function first in 69, in the top 3 in 85.
